## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run check` pass.
- [ ] Checked in Zen (version: …), with the setting on and off when there is one.
- [ ] A new setting has its row in `docs/settings/README.md` and its group page.
- [ ] A line under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Nothing copied from a project under another licence (Nebula is GPL-3.0); code from an MIT project keeps its notice in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`.
